title: Woo Au

page_data.en:
No
610
2/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
September 28th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang received a code telegram from Peking on the 27th inst instructing him to hold himself and his troops in readiness for any emergency owing to the critical situation in the Yangtze Valley. The Director of the Arsenal also received a telegram from Peking enquiring how many rifles and ammunition could be supplied on short notice. The above may be the result of the truculent attitude of General Chang Hsun and his supporters.
The names of 270 rebels forwarded to the repatriation investigation Board by Woo Au 吴阿 who recently opened an office in opposition to the original and official one, have been refused registration by the rebel leaders on the grounds that Woo Au acted as a spy for the Peking Government during the second revolution.
The painters have issued and distributed a circular which states that they have refused and will never accept the increase of 30 cash recently granted by the master painters.
Han Whe 韩惠 and a number of other rebel leaders are holding a meeting at 468 Rue Engene Bard, Frenchtown on the 29th inst to arrange for a memorial service on a large scale in honour of deceased rebels.

Your Obedient Servant,
McLusky Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Capt
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1916年9月28日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：
据报，杨将军于本月27日收到来自北京的密电，指示他及其部队因长江流域局势危急而随时待命，以应对任何紧急情况。兵工厂总监也收到来自北京的一封电报，询问在短时间内能供应多少步枪和弹药。上述情况可能是张勋将军及其支持者采取强硬态度所致。

吴阿（Woo Au）最近开设了一个与原有官方机构相对立的办事处，他向遣返调查委员会提交了270名叛乱分子的名单，但遭到叛乱首领拒绝登记，理由是吴阿在二次革命期间曾充当北京政府的间谍。

油漆工已发布并分发了一份通告，声明他们拒绝并永远不会接受大师傅们最近给予的30文铜钱的加薪。

韩惠（Han Whe）及其他数名叛乱首领将于本月29日在法租界 Eugene Bard 路468号举行会议，安排为已故叛乱分子举行大规模追悼会。

您忠实的仆人，
麦克拉斯基·阿姆斯特朗（McLusky Armstrong）
总探长。

致
警察总监上尉
